capabilities: Create timed and all-day events on a scrollable timeline grid
Link events to vault notes with autocomplete and open them directly
Auto-detect events from dated daily notes (HH:MM title lines)
Toggle Study Mode that colors events by academic subject keywords
Zoom between 1-day and 2-month views and navigate by period
disambiguation: Not a pomodoro or focus timer; it is a timeline calendar for scheduling events, with Study Mode only recoloring study-related ones.
extras: Not yet on Community Plugins, so manual installation of main.js, manifest.json and styles.css is required; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. No external calendar sync; all event data is stored locally in the plugin's data.json. No recurring events and no drag-to-resize in this version.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in visual week or month calendar for scheduling timed events at a glance.

relations.evidence: gives you a Google Calendar-like experience without ever leaving Obsidian

summary: Visual timeline calendar with a scrollable 5:00-23:00 day grid, color-coded events, note linking, daily-note auto-detection, and a Study Mode.
